verdict.rationale: CSC's own marketing says its entity management platform supports secure bi-directional integrations via modern APIs, and that SOP data can be integrated with ELM systems through APIs. That suggests some programmatic access to entity data. However, there is no public API reference, the OpenAPI/llms.txt probes all returned 404, and nothing shows registered-agent appointments can be read or managed via API. missing for 10: publicly documented API reference, evidence of entity record read/write endpoints, registered-agent appointment management via API, developer onboarding/auth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API

citations.quote: Enable secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs
CSC provides integration services for systems like enterprise legal management (ELM), claims, and payroll through secure application programming interfaces (APIs).
